The abliterated member differs BETWEEN arms: experiment 1 used huihui-ai/Huihui-Qwen3-0.6B-abliterated-v2, experiment 2 used mlabonne/Qwen3-0.6B-abliterated. These are NEVER merged.

reproduction.finding: MISMATCH EXPLAINED: the archived value is reproduced EXACTLY only under an ORDINAL rank that breaks the ground-truth tie between the two models whose harmful refusal rate is identically 0.000 (abliterated and SmolLM2-360M) by array order. Under tie-aware average ranks the same data give a different value, and the two admissible tie-breaks bracket a range. The archived rho_SPI = -0.20 vs rho_baseline = +0.40 contrast is therefore an artifact of an arbitrary tie-break, not a property of the estimators.
